title: Gateway session key installation (proposed MQTT 5.0 contract)
description: DRAFT proposal from Owner-approved key-install principles; JSON Schema validation is NOT proof of AES-GCM authenticity, authorization, freshness or key persistence.

gateway_id.description: Canonical MQTT gateway principal/topic identifier (e.g. gw01), not the 1-byte RF Gateway ID.

target_gw_id.description: RF uint8 Gateway ID mapped from authenticated MQTT gateway_id via versioned backend registry; reserved/authorized IDs require semantic checks.

device_mac.description: Six-byte factory device MAC encoded as lowercase hex (no punctuation).

node_id.description: Candidate 1..254 node IDs in target Gateway scope; final RF reserved-code registry remains cross-team review.

session_revision.description: Canonical uint64 decimal string; consumer MUST parse exactly and enforce <=18446744073709551615, no float/JS number conversion.

assignment_revision.description: Canonical uint64 decimal string; consumer MUST parse exactly and enforce <=18446744073709551615, no float/JS number conversion.

session_context_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of exact approved 32-byte SESSION_CONTEXT.

not_before.description: UTC date-time ending Z, with exact semantic ordering checked by consumer.

expires_at.description: UTC date-time ending Z, with exact semantic ordering checked by consumer.

install_deadline.description: UTC date-time ending Z, with exact semantic ordering checked by consumer.

nonce.description: Canonical RFC4648 Base64 (padded where needed) encoding of 12-byte GCM nonce: wrap epoch 4-byte BE || sequence 8-byte BE.

ciphertext.description: Canonical RFC4648 Base64 of exact 64B ciphertext; plaintext is K_SESSION_UP[32] || K_SESSION_DL[32].

tag.description: Canonical RFC4648 Base64 of exact 16B AES-GCM authentication tag.
